caption: A bucket full of water is hauled up out of a well on a rope.

sa.check: A bucket hangs in a well on a rope.
The bucket rises up out of the well.
The bucket is full of water.

pc.expect: The rope hangs straight down to the bucket and stays taut while pulled, and the bucket rises only as fast as rope is taken in.
pc.fail: The rope goes slack while the bucket rises; or the rope stretches; or the bucket rises faster than the rope is taken in.

pc.expect: The bucket hangs below the rope, swinging gently, with the water level in it and any slop running down.
pc.fail: The bucket rises on its own with the rope slack; or it hangs sideways; or water rises out of the bucket.

pc.expect: The bucket rises only while the rope is pulled and stops when the pull stops.
pc.fail: The bucket rises with no pull; or it keeps rising after the pull stops; or it descends while being pulled.

pc.expect: The water slops and settles, and the bucket stays rigid.
pc.fail: The water stays a rigid block; or the bucket bends; or water floats.

pc.expect: One bucket and one rope keep their number.
pc.fail: The bucket vanishes or a second appears; or the rope passes through the bucket's handle; or the bucket turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bucket, the rope and the well stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the rope changes; or the well's stonework rearranges.
